GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.1 (29 Nov 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 365)
29 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Mail Service for Japanese to and from Okinawa and Formosa.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. No. 691(3.3) dated 23 November 1945 from the Central Liaison Office to the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. Mail service, as restricted by Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government AG 311.7 (28 Oct 45) CIS, on established repatriation surface shipping between Japan and Okinawa and return is authorized.
3. At the present time there are no transportation facilities available for Japanese mail service to Formosa and return. At such time as facilities are available the Imperial Japanese Government will be so informed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
